fields.label: Execution mode
fields.description: Built-in backend routing uses the loader's built-in model-family detection and default command builder. Custom command template uses the JSON template below so you can define the CrispASR arguments, companion files, and optional flags yourself.

fields.label: Template preset
fields.description: These presets map to real CrispASR CLI patterns: Kokoro uses --voice voice.gguf, Chatterbox supports --codec-model for the companion S3Gen file, and VibeVoice custom uses --voice for your reference or voice asset.

fields.label: Custom command template JSON
fields.description: Optional JSON object that overrides the preset. Supported keys: argv[], optional[], append_extra_args_setting, append_args[]. Used when Execution mode is Custom command template.

fields.label: Custom asset JSON
fields.description: Optional JSON object for extra files. Common keys: companion_model_path, voice_path, ref_text, instruct_text. Blank values are ignored and not added to the command. Used when Execution mode is Custom command template.

fields.label: Custom parameter JSON
fields.description: Optional JSON object for default parameters such as language or temperature. Used when Execution mode is Custom command template.

fields.label: Voice / reference path (optional)
fields.description: Optional file used by backends that clone or condition on a voice. Common formats are GGUF voice packs for Kokoro or WAV reference audio for some VibeVoice/Chatterbox setups. If left blank, --voice is omitted.

fields.label: Companion model path (optional)
fields.description: Optional extra model file for multi-file backends. For Chatterbox this maps to CrispASR --codec-model and is typically the S3Gen companion GGUF. If left blank, --codec-model is omitted.

fields.label: Reference text (optional)
fields.description: Optional transcript for a reference voice sample when the backend supports paired reference audio plus text.
